lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is consistent across the mid-torso with slight widening towards the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 10th vertical line (anterior-to-posterior) where the line splits at the upper dorsal edge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line terminates at the mid-torso point; the 11th posterior line is highly fragmented, consisting of three abbreviated segments/blobs.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 6 distinct circular spots located on the posterior haunch with higher density on the upper quadrant of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white transverse band is visible across the lower throat; white markings are also present on the distal limb segments above the hooves.
